blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pixel-space diffusion models provide an appealing alternative to latent-space diffusion models by directly modeling raw images without relying on a learned tokenizer. However, scaling pixel-space models has predominantly followed dense strategies, tightly coupling model capacity with active computation. In this work, we show that standard LLM-style Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can be effectively transferred to pixel-space diffusion. Building on this finding, we introduce PixelMoE, a pixel-space generative framework that sparsely scales model capacity with standard LLM-style MoE, without diffusion-specific routing mechanisms or auxiliary routing objectives. Specifically, PixelMoE combines standard Token-Choice (TC) routing with fine-grained routed experts for input-adaptive sparse computation, a shared expert for capturing common representations, and a bias-based load-balancing strategy. To complement sparse capacity scaling, PixelMoE further introduces Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching, which varies spatial resolution along the denoising trajectory from global structure formation to fine-grained detail refinement. At comparable active parameter counts, PixelMoE consistently outperforms its dense counterparts across model scales, demonstrating effective sparse capacity scaling in pixel space. On class-conditional ImageNet-1K, PixelMoE achieves FID scores of 1.47 at 256x256 and 1.53 at 512x512 without representation alignment or perceptual losses, comparing favorably with leading pixel-space and latent-space generative models. Code and models will be released soon.
blocks.zh: 像素-空间传播模型为潜在-空间传播模型提供了一种有吸引力的替代方法,方法是直接对原始图像进行建模,而无需依赖所学的示意器. 然而,缩放像素-空间模型主要遵循密集策略,将模型能力与活性计算紧密相接. 在这部作品中,我们显示标准LLM-风格的Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)架构可以被有效转移到像素-空间传播. 基于这一发现,我们引入了像素-空间基因框架PixelMoE,这个像素-空间基因框架以标准的LLM-风格的MOE来缩小模型容量,没有扩散专用的路由机制或辅助路由目标. 具体来说,PixelMoE将标准Token-Choice(TC)的路由与精致的路由专家结合,用于输入-适应性稀疏的计算,一个用于捕捉共同表述的共享专家,以及基于偏差的负载平衡策略. 为了补充容量稀疏的缩放,PixelMoE进一步引入了Pixel-Space相位相匹配(Pixel-Space signal flow matching),它沿着从全球结构形成到精细细细细化的去诺化轨迹的空间分辨率不同. 在可比的活性参数计数中,PixelMoE在模型尺度上一贯地超过其密集的对等方,显示出在像素空间中有效的容量稀有缩放. 在类条件的ImageNet-1K上,PixelMoE在256x256和512x512上分别取得了1.47分和1.53分的FID分数,没有表现对接或知觉损失,与领先的像素-空间和潜入空间的基因模型进行了有利的比较. 代码和模型将很快发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) trained with flow matching objectives ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , have substantially improved the quality and scalability of image generation.
Most modern diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) denoise in latent spaces extracted by variational autoencoders (VAEs) ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) , whose lossy compression may discard high-frequency details and introduce structural artifacts, leading to a reconstruction bottleneck that limits achievable image fidelity.
Recently, pixel-space diffusion models ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ; Li and He, 2026 ) have regained attention by directly modeling raw images rather than learned latent representations.
Advances in clean-image prediction ( Li and He, 2026 ) , architectural design ( He et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) , and training objectives ( Ma et al., 2026b ) have made raw-pixel modeling easier, enabling pixel-space models to achieve performance competitive with leading latent-space approaches.
blocks.zh:
传播模型的最新进展,特别是传播变形器(DiTs)(Peebles和Xie, 2023年;Ma等人, 2024年),培训了流量匹配目标(Lipman等人, 2023年;Liu等人, 2023年),大大提高了图像生成的质量和可扩展性。
大部分现代扩散模型(Rombach等人,2022年)在变异自编码器(VAEs)提取的潜伏空间(Kingma and Welling,2013年)中隐蔽(Kingma and Welling,2013年),其丢失的压缩可能会丢弃高频细节,引入结构文物,导致重建瓶颈,限制可实现的图像忠心.
最近,像素空间传播模型(Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021;Li and He, 2026)通过直接模拟原始图像而不是学习潜伏的表达方式重新引起注意.
在清洁图像预测(李和贺,2026年),建筑设计(他等人,2026年;于和等人,2026年)以及培训目标(马等人,2026年b)方面的进步,使原始像素模型更容易进行,使像素空间模型能够以领先的潜空方法实现性能竞争力.

blocks.en:
Despite this progress, sparsely scaling pixel-space diffusion remains largely unexplored.
Existing pixel-space models primarily scale their generators densely by increasing model width and depth, tightly coupling capacity growth with active computation.
In contrast, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ) expand total capacity through sparse expert activation while controlling active computation, and have become a standard scaling paradigm in Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .
However, directly transferring standard LLM-style MoE to diffusion has not consistently yielded clear gains over dense counterparts ( Fei et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
Subsequent approaches therefore adopt alternative routing paradigms such as Expert-Choice (EC) ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) , or introduce diffusion-specific routing guidance and objectives ( Wei et al., 2026 ) .
This naturally raises the question: Can standard LLM-style MoE be directly transferred to pixel-space diffusion?
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这一进展,但缩放像素空间的传播仍然基本上没有得到探讨。
现有的像素-空间模型主要通过增加模型宽度和深度,紧密地将容量增长与主动计算结合起来,从而对发电机进行密集的放大.
相比之下,Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)架构(Shazeer等人,2017年)在控制主动计算的同时通过稀疏的专家激活来扩展总容量,并成为大语言模型(LLMs)中的标准缩放范式(Liu等人,2024年).
然而,将标准LLM式的MOE直接转让给扩散,并没有在密集的对应物上取得一致的明显收益(Fei等人,2024年;Liu等人,2025年)。
因此,后续办法采用替代路线模式,如 " 专家选择 " (EC)(Sun等人,2025年;Shi等人,2025年),或采用针对传播的路线指南和目标(Wei等人,2026年)。
这自然引起一个问题: 标准 LLM 风格的 MoE 能直接转移到像素空间扩散吗 ?

blocks.en:
We answer this question affirmatively.
We propose PixelMoE , a Pixel-space Mixture-of-Experts generative framework that sparsely scales pixel-space diffusion transformers without diffusion-specific routing mechanisms or auxiliary routing objectives.
Specifically, PixelMoE adopts standard Token-Choice (TC) routing, where each image token dynamically selects its top- A A experts based on the routing scores.
Each MoE layer combines fine-grained routed experts for input-adaptive sparse computation with a shared expert that captures common representations across image tokens.
To maintain balanced expert utilization without auxiliary balancing objectives, we further adopt a bias-based load-balancing strategy.
Beyond sparse capacity scaling, pixel-space representations can be directly downsampled and upsampled across resolutions while preserving meaningful visual structure.
We exploit this property with Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching, organizing generation into a low-resolution coarse stage followed by full-resolution refinement.
blocks.zh:
我们肯定地回答这个问题。
我们提出PixelMoE,一个像素-空间 Mixture-of-Experts 基因框架,它稀释了像素-空间扩散变压器,没有扩散特定的路由机制或辅助路由目标.
具体来说,PixelMoE采用了标准Token-Choice(TC)的路由,每个图像符号都动态地选择其顶级——A专家根据路由计分.
教育部的每个层将精细的路由专家与一个共享的专家结合在一起,进行输入适应性稀疏的计算,该专家可以捕捉图像符号之间的共同表示。
为了保持专家均衡利用,同时又不实现辅助平衡目标,我们进一步采取了基于偏差的负载平衡战略。
除了容量稀少的缩放外,像素空间的表示可以直接在分辨率之间进行下取样和上取样,同时保留有意义的视觉结构.
我们用像素-太空级流匹配来开发这个地产, 组织一代进入一个低分辨率粗糙的阶段, 然后进行全分辨率的改进。

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments demonstrate strong sparse scaling behavior of PixelMoE.
Under comparable active parameter counts, PixelMoE outperforms its dense counterparts across model scales.
Furthermore, increasing the number of routed experts consistently improves generation quality.
Standard Token-Choice routing also substantially outperforms Expert-Choice routing, without diffusion-specific routing guidance.
Moreover, our routing analysis reveals clear expert specialization across semantic classes and along the denoising trajectory without explicit semantic or timestep guidance.
Together, these results suggest that effective sparse scaling does not require diffusion-specific routing: with appropriately structured sparse capacity, standard Token-Choice routing can effectively exploit the rich semantic and denoising information already encoded in pixel-space representations.
On ImageNet-1K ( Deng et al., 2009 ) , PixelMoE achieves FID scores of 1.47 at 256 × 256 256\times 256 and 1.53 at 512 × 512 512\times 512 without representation alignment ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Shin et al., 2026 ) or perceptual losses ( Ma et al., 2026b ) , comparing favorably with leading pixel-space and latent-space generative models.
These results demonstrate that LLM-style sparse scaling transfers effectively to pixel-space diffusion.
blocks.zh:
广泛的实验显示了PixelMoE的强烈稀疏的缩放行为.
在可比的活性参数计数下,PixelMoE在模型尺度上超过其密集的对应物.
此外,增加路由专家的人数不断提高生成质量。
标准Token-Choice路由也大大超过专家-Choice路由,没有传播专用路由指导.
此外,我们的路线分析显示,各语义班级和在无明确语义或时序指导的去名轨迹沿线都有明确的专家专长。
这些结果表明,有效稀疏的缩放不需要扩散专用的路由:在结构适当的稀疏能力下,标准Token-Choice路由可以有效地利用已经在像素-空间表示中编码的丰富的语义和去诺信息.
在ImageNet-1K(Deng等人,2009年)上,PixelMoE在256×256\time256和512×512 512\time512上实现了1.47的FID分数,没有表示对齐(Yu等人,2025年;Shin等人,2026年)或知觉损失(Ma等人,2026年b),与领先的像素空间和潜在空间基因模型相比是有利的.
这些结果显示,LLM式的稀疏缩放有效向像素空间扩散转移.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early generative models, including GANs ( Brock et al., 2019 ; Casanova et al., 2021 ) and diffusion models ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ; Ho et al., 2022 ) , synthesize images directly in pixel space.
Latent-space models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2021 ) later became dominant by modeling compact representations extracted by variational autoencoders (VAEs) ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) , whose lossy compression introduces a reconstruction bottleneck that limits the achievable generation fidelity.
This limitation has renewed interest in pixel-space generative models, which directly model raw images without lossy compression.
Simple Diffusion ( Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ) demonstrated competitive high-resolution pixel-space generation through architectural scaling, noise schedules, and spatial downsampling, while VDM++ ( Kingma and Gao, 2023 ) studied diffusion-objective weighting and noise augmentation.
JiT ( Li and He, 2026 ) further showed that a large-patch Transformer can effectively model raw pixels through clean-image prediction.
Subsequent approaches improve pixel-space generation through multi-resolution generation ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , neural-field decoding ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , hierarchical architectures ( Yu et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , frequency-decoupled modeling ( Ma et al., 2026a ) , representation alignment ( Shin et al., 2026 ) , perceptual supervision ( Ma et al., 2026b ) , and alternative flow parameterizations ( Chen et al., 2026a ) .
Despite these advances, most existing pixel-space models remain dense, coupling increased model capacity with increased active computation, while sparse MoE scaling in pixel-space diffusion remains underexplored.
blocks.zh:
早期的基因模型,包括GANs(Brock等人,2019年;Casanova等人,2021年)和扩散模型(Dhariwal and Nichol,2021年;Ho等人,2022年),直接在像素空间合成图像.
Latent-space models (Rombach et al., 2022; Esser et al., 2021)后来通过模拟变异自编码器(VAEs)提取的紧凑表示(Kingma and Welling, 2013)而成为主流,其损失压缩引入了重建瓶颈,限制了可实现的生成忠诚.
这种限制重新激发了对像素-空间基因模型的兴趣,这些模型直接对原始图像进行模型化而不会失去压缩.
简单扩散 (Hoogeboom等人,2023年)通过建筑缩放、噪音表和空间下取样,展示了具有竞争力的高分辨率像素空间生成,而VDM++ (Kingma和Gao, 2023)研究扩散-客观的加权和噪声增强.
JiT(Li and He, 2026)进一步显示,一个大片变形器可以通过清真图像预测有效模拟原始像素.
后续方法通过多分辨率生成(Chen等人,2025年),神经-场解码(Wang等人,2026年a),分级架构改善像素-空间生成. (Yu等人,2026年;He等人,2026年;Guo等人,2026年),频率脱钩模型(Ma等人,2026年a),表示对齐(Shin等人,2026年),知觉监督(Ma等人,2026年b),以及替代流参数化(Chen等人,2026年a). 。 。 。
尽管取得了这些进步,但大多数现有的像素-空间模型仍然密集,将增加的模型容量与增加的主动计算相配合,而像素-空间扩散中的稀疏的MOE缩放仍然没有得到充分的探索.

blocks.en:
The Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm was introduced to enable specialization among multiple expert networks ( Jacobs et al., 1991 ) and later extended with sparse gating ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ) .
Modern MoE architectures ( Fedus et al., 2022 ; Dai et al., 2024 ) have become a key scaling mechanism for Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , motivating their adoption in visual generation.
Early expert-based diffusion models, largely built on U-Net backbones, partition the denoising trajectory by noise level, denoising task, or generation path and assign specialized parameters to different regimes ( Balaji et al., 2022 ; Feng et al., 2023 ; Xue et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2024 ; Ganjdanesh et al., 2024 ) .
As diffusion backbones shift toward Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , recent work instead explores sparse expert routing within Transformer blocks.
However, directly applying conventional Token-Choice routing has not consistently yielded clear gains over dense models ( Fei et al., 2024 ) .
Subsequent approaches have therefore introduced Expert-Choice routing ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , diffusion-aware routing or dynamic capacity allocation ( Cheng et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) , and specialized token-expert assignment with auxiliary routing objectives ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) .
However, most existing sparse DiT approaches focus on latent-space diffusion.
JiTMoE ( Liu et al., 2025 ) has recently extended MoE to pixel-space diffusion but reports only modest gains over its dense JiT counterparts.
We therefore investigate whether standard LLM-style sparse MoE can provide systematic scaling gains in pixel-space generation.
blocks.zh:
引入了专家混合模式,使多个专家网络能够实现专业化(Jacobs等人,1991年),后来又以稀疏的 g(Shazeer等人,2017年)。
现代教育部建筑 (Fedus等人,2022年;Dai等人,2024年)已经成为大语言模型(LLMS)的关键缩放机制(Yang等人,2025年;Liu等人,2024年),激发在视觉生成中采用.
早期基于专家的传播模式,主要建立在U-Net主干线上,通过噪声水平分割去除声轨迹,去除任务,或生成路径,并为不同的系统指定专门参数(Balaji等人,2022年;Feng等人,2023年;薛等人,2023年;Lee等人,2024年;Ganjdanesh等人,2024年).
随着传播骨干转向传播变形器(DiTs)(Peebles and Xie, 2023年),最近的工作反而在变形器块内探索稀缺的专家路径.
然而,直接采用传统的Token-Choice路由方法并没有在密度模型上取得一致的明显收益(Fei等人,2024年)。
因此,后续办法引入了专家-选择路线(Sun等人,2025年),传播-意识路线或动态能力分配(Cheng等人,2025年;Shi等人,2025年),以及具有辅助路线目标的专职象征性专家任务(Yuan等人,2025年;Wei等人,2026年)。
然而,大多数现有的零星的DiT方法侧重于潜在的空间传播。
JiTMoE(Liu等人,2025年)最近将MOE扩展为像素-空间传播,但报告相对于密集的JiT对应物而言,进展不大。
因此,我们调查标准LLM风格的稀疏MOE是否能够提供像素空间生成的系统缩放增益.

blocks.en: 3 PixelMoE: Pixel-Space Diffusion with Mixture-of-Experts
blocks.zh: 3像素MoE:与专家混合的像素空间扩散

blocks.en:
PixelMoE is a pixel-space generative framework designed to sparsely scale model capacity with standard LLM-style Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), while employing Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching for coarse-to-fine generation.
As illustrated in the left panel of Figure 3 , generation proceeds through two stages at different spatial resolutions.
Stage 0 performs partial denoising at low resolution to establish global structure, while Stage 1 continues denoising at full resolution for detail refinement.
The two stages share the PixelMoE backbone and Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT) ( Wang et al., 2026b ) prediction head.
The backbone consists of initial dense blocks followed by sparse PixelMoE blocks, while the DDT head performs stage-wise endpoint prediction.
blocks.zh:
像素 MOE是一个像素-空间基因框架,旨在以标准的LLM-风格的Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)来稀释模型容量,同时采用Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching来进行粗对细生成.
如图3左面板所示,生成过程在不同空间分辨率上分两个阶段进行。
第0阶段以低分辨率进行部分解析,以建立全球结构,而第1阶段则继续以完全解析的方式进行详细改进。
两个阶段共用PixelMoE骨干和脱钩的分散变形器(DDT)(Wang等人,2026b)预测头.
骨干由最初密集的块组成,然后是稀疏的像素MoE块,而滴滴涕头则进行阶段性终点预测。

blocks.en:
As shown in the right panel of Figure 3 , each PixelMoE block consists of a self-attention layer followed by an LLM-style sparse MoE layer.
For each image token, standard Token-Choice routing selects a subset of fine-grained routed experts, while a shared expert is always activated to capture common representations across image tokens.
To maintain balanced expert utilization without an auxiliary load-balancing objective, we further introduce a balancing bias during routing.
Importantly, the router operates directly on pixel-token representations without explicit semantic or timestep routing guidance.
We detail the sparse MoE design and the hierarchical flow formulation in the following subsections.
blocks.zh:
如图3右面板所示,每个像素MoE块由自留层组成,然后是LLM风格的稀疏MoE层.
对于每个图像符号,标准Token-Choice路由选择一组精细的路由专家,而共享的专家总是被激活来捕捉跨图像符号的共同表示.
为了在不附带负载平衡目标的情况下保持专家的均衡利用,我们在路由过程中进一步引入平衡偏差.
重要的是,路由器在没有明确的语义或时间步路由指导的情况下直接在像素键表示上运行.
在以下各小节中,我们详细介绍了教育部的稀疏设计和分级流程的表述。

Figure 3: Overview of PixelMoE. Left: PixelMoE performs Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching using a shared PixelMoE backbone and DDT prediction head; the initial dense blocks are omitted for clarity.
Right: Each PixelMoE block consists of self-attention followed by an LLM-style sparse MoE layer with Token-Choice routed experts and a shared expert.
A balancing bias is employed to maintain balanced expert utilization.

blocks.en: 3.1 LLM-Style Mixture-of-Experts for Pixel-Space Diffusion
blocks.zh: 3.1 用于像素空间扩散的LLM-Style混合技术

blocks.en:
The core design of PixelMoE is to directly transfer the standard LLM-style MoE paradigm to pixel-space diffusion.
Following modern LLM-style MoE architectures ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) , we retain dense feed-forward networks (FFNs) in the early Transformer blocks and replace the FFNs in the remaining blocks with sparse MoE layers.
Each MoE layer adopts standard Token-Choice routing over pixel-token representations, combines fine-grained routed experts with a shared expert, and employs a bias-based load-balancing strategy without an auxiliary objective.
blocks.zh:
PixelMoE的核心设计是将标准的LLM风格的MOE范式直接转移到像素-空间的传播上.
遵循现代LLM风格的MOE架构 (刘等人,2024年;基米. Team et al, 2026),我们保留了早期变形器区块中密集的向导网络(FFNs),并将剩余区块中的FFN替换为稀疏的MOE层.
每个MOE层采用标准Token-Choice路由在像素-token表达方式之上,将精细纹理的路由专家与共享专家结合,并采用偏重式负载平衡策略,没有辅助目标.

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching in PixelMoE. PixelMoE is jointly trained on a low-resolution coarse stage and a full-resolution refinement stage with stage-wise endpoint prediction.
During sampling, generation first follows the low-resolution Stage 0 flow to obtain a coarse endpoint, which is then transitioned to the Stage 1 starting state for full-resolution refinement.

blocks.en:
Pixel space naturally supports coarse-to-fine generation, as spatial resampling directly produces meaningful multi-resolution images.
We therefore vary the spatial resolution along the denoising trajectory, using coarse representations during early denoising and full-resolution representations for later refinement.
This hierarchical trajectory also requires the model to process heterogeneous pixel-token representations across resolutions and noise levels, which are naturally accommodated by the input-adaptive routing of PixelMoE.
Specifically, Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching organizes generation into two stages: Stage 0 performs partial denoising at low resolution for coarse structure modeling, while Stage 1 continues at full resolution for detail refinement.
As illustrated in Figure 4 , both stages share the same PixelMoE model while denoising at different spatial resolutions and noise levels.

这种分级的轨迹也要求模型处理不同像素的表达方式,跨越分辨率和噪声水平,而像素MoE的输入适应性路由自然地适应了这些表达方式.
具体来说,像素-空间等级 流程匹配将生成组织为两个阶段: 0阶段在低分辨率下进行部分解析,用于粗结构模型,而1阶段则继续完全解析,以供详细改进。

blocks.en: 4.1 Sparse Scaling Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 碎片放大分析

blocks.en:
We first investigate whether sparse MoE scaling can effectively improve pixel-space generation.
We study the sparse scaling behavior of PixelMoE from three perspectives: active parameter scaling, expert scaling, and computation scaling via token granularity.
blocks.zh:
我们首先调查MOE的缩放是否能有效改善像素-空间生成.
我们从三个角度研究PixelMoE的稀疏的缩放行为:活动参数缩放,专家缩放,和通过符号颗粒度计算缩放。

blocks.en: (a) Effect of scaling the number of experts.
blocks.zh: (a) 扩大专家人数的影响。

blocks.en: (b) Computation scaling via token granularity.
blocks.zh: (b) 通过象征性颗粒进行计算。

blocks.en: Table 2: Sparse scaling analysis of PixelMoE. #PS denotes the patch size.
blocks.zh: 表2: PixelMoE的Sparse缩放分析. #PS表示补丁大小.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Expert routing across semantic classes and along the denoising trajectory. The left panel shows expert routing across ImageNet-1K classes, while the right panel shows how routing evolves along the denoising trajectory.
blocks.zh: 图6:跨语义类的专家路线和去名轨迹。 左侧面板显示专家的路由跨越ImageNet-1K类,而右侧面板则显示路由如何沿去诺音轨演变.

blocks.en:
We first compare PixelMoE with its dense counterparts across model scales.
For controlled comparisons, each dense baseline uses the same hierarchical flow setup and training recipe as its PixelMoE counterpart, with sparse MoE layers replaced by dense FFNs at comparable active parameter counts.
As shown in Figure 5 , PixelMoE consistently achieves lower FID than dense models across Base, Large, and Huge scales.
Beyond generation quality, we compare the convergence of Dense-L and PixelMoE-L-E32A4, extending the training to 200 200 epochs for this analysis.
As shown in Figure 5 , PixelMoE-L-E32A4 reaches the FID achieved by Dense-L at 200 200 epochs after only about 71 71 epochs, reducing the required training epochs by a factor of approximately 2.8 2.8 .
These results show that sparse MoE scaling improves generation quality while also accelerating convergence at comparable active parameter counts.
blocks.zh:
我们首先比较PixelMoE和它的密集的模型尺度。
对于可控比较,每个稠密基线使用与PixelMoE对应的相同的分级流设置和培训配方,在可比的活性参数计数时,稀疏的MOE层被稠密的FFN所取代.
如图5所示,PixelMoE在整个基地、大型和大型尺度上始终实现低于密集模型的FID。
除了生成质量外,我们比较了Dense-L和PixelMoE-L-E32A4的趋同,将这项分析的培训扩展到200个世纪。
如图5所示,PixelMoE-L-E32A4在约71个71个世纪之后,在200个世纪达到Dense-L达到的FID,使所需的培训时代减少大约2.8个2.8个世纪。
这些结果表明,教育部的小规模工作提高了发电质量,同时也加快了可比有效参数数的趋同。

blocks.en:
We next isolate the effect of sparse model capacity by varying the number of routed experts E E while fixing the number of activated experts to A = 4 A=4 .
As shown in Table 2(a) , increasing E E from 8 8 to 16 16 and then 32 32 improves FID from 2.28 2.28 to 2.03 2.03 and 1.78 1.78 , respectively, while keeping the active parameter count fixed at 632 632 M.
This shows that PixelMoE effectively benefits from increased total model capacity without increasing the number of active parameters.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们通过改变路线专家E E 的人数来隔离模型容量稀少的影响,同时将激活的专家人数固定为A = 4 A = 4。
如表2(a)所示,EE从8个8个增加到16个16个,然后增加32个32个FID,分别从2.28个2.28个增加到2.03个2.03个和1.78个1.78个,同时将有效参数计数固定在632 632 M。
这表明,PixelMoE在不增加有效参数的情况下,有效地受益于总模型容量的增加.

blocks.en:
We further study how PixelMoE benefits from increased computation by reducing the patch size, which increases the token sequence length while keeping the backbone scale fixed.
As shown in Table 2(b) , PixelMoE consistently outperforms the dense models at both patch sizes, with a larger improvement at finer token granularity.
A possible explanation is that smaller patches produce more spatially localized token representations and provide more token-level routing decisions, enabling the router to exploit finer-grained spatial variation.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步研究PixelMoE如何通过减少补丁大小而从增加的计算中获益,这增加了符号序列长度,同时保持主干尺度的固定.
如表2(b)所示,PixelMoE在两个补丁尺寸上都一贯优于密集型号,在更细的代号颗粒度上有更大的改进.
一个可能的解释是,较小的补丁会产生空间定位性更强的代号表示,并提供更多的代号级的路由决定,使路由器能够利用更细的纹理空间变异.

blocks.en: 4.2 Expert Specialization
blocks.zh: 4.2 专家

blocks.en:
We analyze the routing behavior of PixelMoE-L-E32A4 on the ImageNet-1K validation set.
For selected MoE layers, we collect token-level routing assignments and examine how expert preferences vary across semantic classes and along the denoising trajectory.
We report the log 2 \log_{2} ratio of the observed assignment frequency to that under uniform routing, where positive and negative values indicate preferred and suppressed experts, respectively.
blocks.zh:
我们分析PixelMoE-L-E32A4在ImageNet-1K验证集上的路由行为.
对于特定的教育部层,我们收集符号级的路由分配,并研究专家的偏好如何在语义类和去名轨迹上有所不同。
我们报告所观测到的任务频率与统一路线下的比例,正值和负值分别表明偏好和压制专家。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 6 , PixelMoE exhibits distinct routing patterns across semantic classes and along the denoising trajectory.
Class-dependent routing is relatively weak in shallow layers, becomes clearer in intermediate layers, and is most pronounced around Layers 12–20, where different ImageNet-1K classes favor different subsets of experts.
In contrast, routing along the denoising trajectory is already prominent in shallow layers, weakens in intermediate layers, and emerges strongly again in the final layer.
The routing pattern also changes noticeably across the transition between the two hierarchical stages.
Overall, class-dependent routing specialization is more pronounced in intermediate layers, whereas specialization along the denoising trajectory is stronger in shallow and final layers.
blocks.zh:
如图6所示,PixelMoE在语义类和去诺化轨迹上展现出不同的路由模式.
类依赖的路由在浅层相对薄弱,中间层变得更加清晰,在12–20层周围最为显著,不同的ImageNet-1K类偏爱不同的子集专家.
与此相反,沿去诺氏轨迹的路由已经在浅层中突出,在中间层中弱化,并在最后层中再次强烈出现.
在两个等级阶段之间的过渡过程中,路线模式也发生了显著变化。
总体而言,中层更突出的是依赖阶级的路由专业化,而沿去诺化轨迹的专业化则在浅层和最后层更为明显.

blocks.en:
Figure 7: Global expert utilization across layers. The routed expert loads of PixelMoE-L-E32A4 remain close to a uniform distribution across the analyzed MoE layers.
Expert loads are normalized by their expected values under uniform routing, with the dashed line indicating 1.
blocks.zh:
图7:全球各层专家利用情况。 PixelMoE-L-E32A4的路由专家载荷仍然接近于在所分析的MOE层之间统一分布.
专家负载按统一路线下的预期值正常化,虚线表示1.

blocks.en:
The specialized routing patterns above could potentially arise from persistent over-utilization of a small subset of experts.
We therefore examine the global routed-expert loads across different MoE layers of PixelMoE-L-E32A4.
For each layer, we accumulate expert assignments over the ImageNet-1K validation set and report the resulting expert-load distribution.
As shown in Figure 7 , the routed
expert loads remain close to the uniform distribution across all analyzed layers.
This indicates that the bias-based load-balancing strategy effectively maintains globally balanced expert utilization while preserving input-adaptive expert specialization.
Together, these results show that the observed routing patterns across semantic classes and along the denoising trajectory do not simply reflect persistent over-utilization of a small subset of experts.
blocks.zh:
以上专门路线模式可能源于对一小批专家的持续过度利用。
因此,我们审查不同层的像素MoE-L-E32A4的全球路线专家负荷。
对于每一层,我们通过ImageNet-1K验证集积累专家任务,并报告由此产生的专家负荷分布。
如图7所示,路由
专家负荷仍然接近所有分析层的统一分布。
这表明,基于偏差的负载平衡战略有效地维持了全球平衡的专家利用,同时保持了适应性输入的专家专业化。
这些结果加在一起表明,所观察到的跨语义类的路线模式和去名轨迹并非只是反映了对少数专家的持续过度利用。

blocks.en: 4.3 Benchmarking against Previous Systems
blocks.zh: 4.3 参照以往系统制定基准

blocks.en:
Table 3 compares PixelMoE with representative latent-space and pixel-space generative systems on class-conditional ImageNet-1K at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution.
PixelMoE-B-E32A4 achieves an FID of 1.88 1.88 with only 225 225 M active parameters.
As total model capacity increases, PixelMoE-L-E32A4 further improves the FID to 1.54 1.54 , while PixelMoE-H-E32A4 reaches 1.47 1.47 .
Notably, these results are achieved without representation alignment ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Shin et al., 2026 ) or perceptual losses ( Ma et al., 2026b ) .
Compared with leading dense pixel-space models, PixelMoE achieves better generation quality.
PixelMoE also remains competitive with leading latent-space approaches without relying on a learned VAE.
Together with the controlled scaling results in Figures 5 and 2(a) , these comparisons support LLM-style sparse MoE as an effective scaling paradigm for pixel-space generative modeling.
blocks.zh:
表3 比较 具有代表性潜在空间和像素空间基因系的像素MoE以256×256256\times 256分辨率在类条件ImageNet-1K上.
PixelMoE-B-E32A4实现1.88 1.88的FID,只有225 225 M的活性参数.
随着模型总容量的增加,PixelMoE-L-E32A4进一步将FID改进为1.54 1.54,而PixelMoE-H-E32A4则达到1.47 1.47.
值得注意的是,这些结果的实现没有表示一致(Yu等人,2025年;Shin等人,2026年)或认知损失(Ma等人,2026年b)。
与领先的密集像素空间模型相比,像素MoE实现了更好的生成质量.
PixelMoE在领先的潜在空间方法上也仍然具有竞争力,而无需依赖知识丰富的VAE.
与图5和图2(a)中的可控缩放结果一起,这些比较支持LLM风格的稀疏MOE作为像素-空间基因模型的有效缩放范式.

blocks.en:
We next examine whether this sparse scaling behavior of PixelMoE extends to higher-resolution pixel-space generation.
As shown in Table 4 , all PixelMoE models retain the same E32A4 sparse MoE design at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution.
PixelMoE-B-E32A4 achieves an FID of 2.05 2.05 , while PixelMoE-L-E32A4 and PixelMoE-H-E32A4 further improve the FID to 1.58 1.58 and 1.53 1.53 , respectively.
Despite the substantially increased dimensionality of the pixel-space generation problem, PixelMoE maintains strong generation performance across model scales and remains competitive with representative dense pixel-space and latent-space generative models.
These results further demonstrate that the sparse scaling behavior of PixelMoE extends from 256 × 256 256\times 256 to higher-resolution pixel-space generation.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来要检查的是,PixelMoE的这种稀疏的缩放行为是否延伸至更高分辨率的像素-空间生成.
如表4所示,所有像素MoE型号都保留了512×512 512\times 512分辨率的相同的E32A4稀疏的MOE设计.
PixelMoE-B-E32A4实现了2.05 2.05的FID,而PixelMoE-L-E32A4和PixelMoE-H-E32A4则将FID分别进一步提高到1.58 1.58和1.53 1.53.
尽管像素-空间生成问题的维度大幅提高,但像素MoE在模型尺度上保持了强大的生成性能,并且仍然与具有代表性的密集像素-空间和潜在空间基因模型具有竞争力.
这些结果进一步证明,像素MoE的稀疏的缩放行为从256×256256\times 256延伸到更高分辨率的像素-空间生成.

blocks.en:
Qualitative results are shown in Figure 8 .
PixelMoE generates coherent images across diverse ImageNet-1K categories, with clear global structures and rich local textures.
These samples further illustrate the strong visual fidelity of PixelMoE.
blocks.zh:
定性结果见图8。

这些样本进一步说明了PixelMoE的强烈视觉忠诚.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We conduct ablation studies on the key components of PixelMoE.
The sparse MoE design and explicit routing guidance are evaluated on PixelMoE-L-E32A4, while the hierarchical flow schedule, stage-aware timestep sampling, and DDT prediction head are evaluated on PixelMoE-B-E32A4.
Unless otherwise specified, the experiments follow the default training recipe; for the hierarchical flow comparison, we adjust the number of training iterations to match the total number of processed image tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们对PixelMoE的关键组件进行消化研究.
在PixelMoE-L-E32A4上评价了少量的MOE设计和明确的路由指导,而在PixelMoE-B-E32A4上评价了分级流量表,阶段感知时间步取样,以及滴滴涕预测头.
除非另有说明,实验遵循默认的训练食谱;为了进行分级的流量比较,我们调整训练迭代的次数,以配合处理过的图像符号的总数.

blocks.en: (a) Effect of the shared expert.
blocks.zh: (a) 共同专家的效力。

blocks.en: (b) Ablation on fine-grained routed experts.
blocks.zh: (b) 对经过精细处理的路由专家进行虐待。

blocks.en: (c) Comparison of load-balancing strategies.
blocks.zh: (c) 负载平衡战略的比较。

blocks.en: (d) Token-Choice vs. Expert-Choice routing.
blocks.zh: (d) Token-Choice对专家-Choice路线。

blocks.en: Table 5: Ablation studies of the sparse MoE design in PixelMoE-L-E32A4.
blocks.zh: 表5: PixelMoE-L-E32A4中稀疏的MOE设计的研究.

blocks.en:
We first examine the role of the shared expert in Table 5(a) .
Under matched active parameter counts, introducing a shared expert improves FID from 2.22 2.22 to 1.78 1.78 , while reducing the total parameter count from 2.00 2.00 B to 1.65 1.65 B.
This suggests that combining shared and routed computation is more effective than allocating the entire active parameter budget to routed experts.
blocks.zh:
我们首先在表5(a)中审查共同专家的作用。
在匹配的有效参数计数下,采用共享专家将FID从2.222.22提高到1.781.78,同时将总参数计数从2.02.0B减少到1.651.65B.
这表明,将共享和路由计算结合起来,比将整个活动参数预算分配给路由专家更为有效。

blocks.en:
We next study the effect of expert granularity under matched total and active parameter counts.
As shown in Table 5(b) , changing the expert configuration from E8A1 to E32A4 expands the number of possible expert combinations from 8 8 to 35,960 35{,}960 without increasing either total or active parameter count.
The corresponding FID improvement from 1.95 1.95 to 1.78 1.78 indicates that PixelMoE benefits from finer-grained expert composition.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来研究专家颗粒性在匹配总参数和活性参数计数下的影响。
如表5(b)所示,将专家配置从E8A1改为E32A4,使可能的专家组合数量从8个8个增加到35,960个35{,}960个,同时不增加总参数或活动参数数.
相应的FID改进从1.95 1.95提高到1.78 1.78,表明PixelMoE得益于精细的加分专家构成.

blocks.en:
The bias-based load-balancing strategy offers a simple but effective way to regulate expert utilization without introducing an auxiliary loss.
As shown in Table 5(c) , the bias-based strategy improves FID from 2.05 2.05 to 1.78 1.78 compared with an auxiliary load-balancing loss, with identical total and active parameter counts.
Together with the expert-utilization analysis in Figure 7 , this result indicates that PixelMoE can preserve flexible input-adaptive routing while maintaining balanced global expert utilization.
blocks.zh:
基于偏差的负载平衡战略提供了一个简单但有效的方法,在不造成辅助损失的情况下调节专家的利用。
如表5(c)所示,基于偏差的战略使FID从2.052.05提高到1.781.78, 与辅助负载平衡损失相比,总参数和有效参数计算相同。
与图7中的专家利用分析一起,这一结果表明,PixelMoE可以保持灵活的输入适应路线,同时保持全球专家平衡利用。

blocks.en:
We compare Token-Choice and Expert-Choice routing to examine which routing paradigm is better suited to pixel-space diffusion.
We implement DiffMoE ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , which adopts Expert-Choice routing, using the same pixel-space backbone and training recipe as PixelMoE while keeping the total and active parameter counts comparable.
As shown in Table 5(d) , Token-Choice routing achieves a substantially lower FID.

blocks.en:
A natural question is whether expert routing requires explicit timestep or semantic information.
For timestep-aware routing, we provide the timestep embedding directly to the router together with the token hidden states; for semantics-aware routing, we follow the semantic routing design of ProMoE ( Wei et al., 2026 ) .
As shown in Table 6(a) , neither variant improves upon the default PixelMoE router, which makes routing decisions solely from token hidden states.
Together with the expert specialization observed across semantic classes and along the denoising trajectory in Figure 6 , these results suggest that token hidden states in pixel-space diffusion already contain rich timestep and semantic cues that support effective routing without explicit guidance.

一个自然的问题是,专家的路由需要明确的时间步骤还是语义信息。

这些结果表明,像素空间传播中隐藏的象征状态已经含有丰富的时序和语义提示,在没有明确指导的情况下支持有效的路由。

blocks.en:
The pixel-space hierarchical flow schedule progressively changes the spatial granularity along the denoising trajectory.
We compare it with a single-stage counterpart that performs the entire denoising process at full resolution.
For a fair comparison, we adjust the number of training iterations such that both variants process the same total number of image tokens.
As shown in Table 6(b) , hierarchical flow improves FID from 2.54 2.54 to 2.46 2.46 .
This result shows the benefit of adapting spatial granularity along the denoising trajectory by using coarser representations for early denoising and finer representations for later refinement.

The baseline uses a single global Logit-Normal distribution ( μ g , δ g ) = ( 0.8 , 0.8 ) (\mu_{\mathrm{g}},\delta_{\mathrm{g}})=(0.8,0.8) to sample timesteps over the complete denoising trajectory.

We further ablate the Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT) prediction head ( Wang et al., 2026b ) on PixelMoE-B-E32A4.
Without DDT, the backbone features are mapped directly to the high-dimensional pixel-space prediction, whereas the default model introduces a wider prediction pathway after the backbone.
As shown in Table 6(d) , the DDT head improves FID from 3.76 3.76 to 2.46 2.46 .
This result supports the use of the DDT prediction head in our final configuration.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This paper presents PixelMoE , a pixel-space image generation framework that sparsely scales model capacity by directly adopting an LLM-style Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture.
We further incorporate Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching to progressively increase spatial resolution along the denoising trajectory.
Experiments on ImageNet-1K show that PixelMoE consistently outperforms its dense counterparts across model scales and achieves competitive performance relative to leading latent- and pixel-space generative models.
Our routing analyses further reveal clear expert specialization across semantic classes and along the denoising trajectory under standard Token-Choice routing, without explicit semantic or timestep routing guidance.
These results support LLM-style sparse MoE as an effective scaling paradigm for pixel-space generative modeling.
blocks.zh:
本文介绍PixelMoE,是一个像素空间图像生成框架,通过直接采用LLM风格的Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)架构来缩小模型容量.
我们进一步纳入了像素-空间级流匹配,以逐步提高去诺氏轨迹的空间分辨率。
在ImageNet-1K上的实验显示,PixelMoE在模型尺度上一直比其密集的对等方表现优于领先的潜伏和像素空间基因模型,并实现了竞争性能.
我们的路由分析进一步揭示了各语义类和在标准Token-Choice路由下去Noing轨迹上的清晰的专家专业化,没有明确的语义或时间步路由指导.
这些结果支持LLM风格的稀疏MOE作为像素空间基因模型的有效缩放范式.

We implement PixelMoE at Base, Large, and Huge scales, with the detailed configurations summarized in Table 7 .
For 256 × 256 256\times 256 generation, all models use a patch size of 8 8 ; we use a patch size of 16 16 at 512 × 512 512\times 512 .

A wide DDT head is appended to each backbone for stage-wise endpoint prediction, using 2 2 , 2 2 , and 4 4 blocks for the Base, Large, and Huge models, respectively.

Unless otherwise specified, the same training recipe is used across model scales.

blocks.en:
For controlled comparisons, each dense baseline follows the same backbone configuration, hierarchical flow schedule, DDT prediction head, optimizer, timestep sampling, and training recipe as the corresponding PixelMoE model.
The sparse MoE layers are replaced by dense FFNs with comparable active parameter counts, while all other architectural and training settings are kept unchanged.

For the final PixelMoE-H-E32A4 models, we introduce additional regularization after epoch 200 200 .

The router operates in FP32 and converts the routing logits into sigmoid scores.
For each image token, we select the top- A A experts according to the bias-adjusted scores, normalize the original sigmoid scores over the selected experts, and multiply the resulting routing weights by a scale factor of A \sqrt{A} before expert aggregation.
The balancing bias only affects expert selection and is not used when computing the expert routing weights.
After each optimizer update, expert loads accumulated during the corresponding forward passes are used to update the balancing bias with an RMS-normalized correction and a step size of 0.001 0.001 .
No auxiliary load-balancing objective is used for the default PixelMoE models.
